ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback and we apologize for the frustrating experience you are having with your grill. 

If you’re using the grill with a standard size tank you might have tripped a safety device built into the hose. The safety device is designed to detect gas leaks, so the first thing to do is test your grill for any gas leaks. If you have a leak, do not use the grill! You can trick the safety into thinking there is a gas leak if you don’t light the grill properly. When it believes there is a gas leak, the gas flow to the grill is reduced down to 10%. The grill won’t be able to get up to normal grilling temperatures. When a grill is in this situation, we say it’s in “bypass”.

To get the grill out of bypass, please use the following instructions for lighting the grill. These same instructions will also get a grill out of bypass.

· Make sure the control knob is in the off position.
· Open the grill lid.
· Open the valve on the propane tank all the way, and then wait for about 60 seconds.
· Turn the control knob to START/HIGH and press the igniter button.
· Once the burner is lit, close the lid and in 10 to 15 minutes the grill should reach 500 to 550F.
· Always make sure to turn the control knob to OFF after you are done using the grill.

If these instructions do not help, we recommend trying a disposable canister. If the grill works normally with the disposable canister then the hose will need to be replaced. If it does NOT work with the disposable canister, then the valve/regulator will need to be replaced.

Please look for a follow-up email from our Care team. Your satisfaction is very important to us. Thank you!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We want you to get the most out of your grill, and we are sorry to learn that you are disappointed.

With the lid closed and empty grates, a brand-new grill will run hotter than usual. We recommend running the grill on low with the grates filled with food in order to determine the low temperature. We expect it to be about 375F.

If you are interested in doing low-and-slow cooking, a model with more area for indirect cooking could be a better fit.

Your satisfaction is very important to us. Please look for an email outreach from our Care team soon. Thank you!

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback, thank you! 

This grill is designed to be used with either a 1lb tank or a 20lb tank and a Weber adapter hose. 

Using this grill with an internal RV will result in double-regulation of the gas flow, resulting in a grill that will not light. 

If you are interested in using a Weber Q 1200 with an internal RV tank ONLY, we have a model that is designed for this type of connection. Please note that this model is not adaptable for use with a 1lb or 20lb LP canister.

Your satisfaction is our top priority! Please look for an email outreach from our Care team soon. Thank you!
